title: Approval
description: Maps to the 'Human Approvals' entity in docs/claimflow-luo-playbook.md, Phase 1. The playbook's own Step 2.3 UI ('Approve Both & Dispatch', 'Edit Drafts', 'Reject / Escalate') maps onto this entity's decision values rather than adding new ones: Approve Both & Dispatch -> approved, Edit Drafts -> approved_with_edits, Reject / Escalate -> rejected (with escalation captured in notes/severity, not as a separate decision). NOTE: the playbook's Phase 1 prompt asked for a Timestamp field, but a live inspection of the Luo build (2026-09-25 migration inventory) found human_approval has no timestamp column at all - timestamp is kept here as the intended/target field but marked optional, not required, until the live implementation actually has it.
